catalog_transfer.heading: Import a catalog file
catalog_transfer.description: Upload a JSON file exported from this or another site to re-create a listing or group — or a bundle file that holds many listings and groups at once. Everything comes with its prices, group memberships, and parent references. Any referenced parent listings and groups must already exist here, and each imported name must not already be in use.
catalog_transfer.no_file: Please select a JSON file to import.
catalog_transfer.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
catalog_transfer.imported_bundle: {listings, plural, one {1 listing} other {# listings}} and {groups, plural, one {1 group} other {# groups}} imported.
catalog_transfer.bundle_failed: No records were created. Please fix these problems and upload the file again:
catalog_transfer.group_missing: A group used by this import no longer exists. Please import again.
catalog_transfer.member_missing: A listing used by this import no longer exists. Please import again.
catalog_transfer.parent_missing: A parent listing used by this import no longer exists. Please import again.
catalog_transfer.site_plan_listing_refus: Listings that assign a site on booking can't be imported. Create ''{name}'' on this site instead.
catalog_transfer.demo_disabled: Catalog import is disabled in demo mode.
